title: Fort Dearborn monument: Black Partridge's long hair, the warrior's curl
items: On the Fort Dearborn monument (18th Street, 1904), Black Partridge's long hair now falls from under the back of his headband and streams back behind his neck to his left shoulder, as both photographs show it. Before, his head carried only a short crop.
The warrior has the lock of hair the photographs show hanging from under his headband past his cheek, curled at its end.
